deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release rdx-runtime v2.3.1 -> 10% traffic. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/rdx-runtime-v2.3.1 :rocket:
ana: Acknowledged. I'm owner for this window (15:00-16:00 UTC). I'll be monitoring. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout-playbook :eyes:
mike: Quick checklist: metrics alerts on, canary logs streaming to #eng-oncall, tracing enabled. If error_rate > 1% sustained for 3m -> backout. :warning:
liam: Runtime change is kernel selector tweak + KV cache tweak. Expect small memory bump. Watch p95 latency and memory OOMs.
tina_ops: Oncall will keep the rollback command ready. @mike @liam who will execute the pin if we need to revert?
mike: I'll run the rollback. Command in the runbook: ```redwoodctl deploy revert --service rdx-runtime --to v2.3.0 --reason "canary-failure"```
ana: Explicit backout triggers: 1) increased user-facing errors >1% for 3+ minutes, 2) p95 latency >200ms for 5+ minutes on API endpoints, 3) any client-visible regression reported by Support with reproducible example.
liam: Add early warning: if queueing for GPU inference increases by >30% for 10m, escalate. That often precedes timeouts.
oncall-bot: Alert policy active: canary-error-rate-policy (1% / 3m), canary-latency-policy (200ms / 5m) -> routing to #eng-oncall, pager on.
tina_ops: If we decide to back out, use the safe rollback path: 1) quorum from release lead + oncall + runtime lead, 2) run `redwoodctl deploy revert` on primary region, 3) pin models on serving routes for a rolling fallback, 4) confirm metrics return to baseline, 5) notify customers. See runbook section 3.2 for commands.
mike: Executing dry-run of revert now (no effect): ```redwoodctl deploy revert --service rdx-runtime --to v2.3.0 --dry-run``` -> looks clean.
nana: Good. If we back out, annotate the release notes with cause and which signal triggered backout. I'll handle comms.
liam: I'll watch kernel logs and KV cache mem stats, posting notable spikes here.
mike: no alerts yet. p50/p95 within expected. Canary at 10% for 12m.
